limitations: No ASR timestamp was overridden and no first-take timing was reused.
A low-energy interval inside a timestamped word is not an executable deletion candidate.
The generous wave-only bound is deliberately unsafe to execute; even it can show that quiet shortening cannot provide enough time under the stated pause/guard policy.
Signal span includes all original PCM between sentence-boundary quiet regions, including intentional in-sentence pauses. It is not a human phonetic label of every sample.
Root/independent review of any exact new edit map is required before application. No edit map or shortened WAV has been applied.
